items.item: H11 (the direction takes J1/J2, not C)
items.how: Confirmed. USES People-and-AI Conditional: 'conditional on the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, comparing moves by widening' (H11's front wording); the handover's italic line and paragraph: verdicts take J1/J2 (`Requirement.Handover.direction` takes `Priority`), C met wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic condition (`Priority.comparison`); the Lean gives better 2 1, better 2 0 and expansion excluded from J1/J2 alone, as said. No 'C read as widening' remains among any hypotheses on the four pages.

C is defined on these pages only in the handover: 'a plan rank above every plan it extends, keeping every basic condition and gain the other has and adding a gain' is `Extension (tierFrame …) gainSide`, the frame's living. The short gloss 'above every course it widens' appears nowhere on the four pages.

items.item: H13 (seeing needed for a choice to answer to a loss; the lake as the test's result)
items.how: Confirmed in In brief, human development's Argued line and the lake, both languages; the lake says 'in the test no instruction tried preserved it', as experiments/direction-installation/README.md and the example's own opening say.

In brief: 'Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach: there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens', with 'there' tied to 'where the condition holds, read across all steps' (the first screen now places it the same way), so it cannot be read as holding under the in-time reading, which no theorem composes with self-concern. The checklist and the valley define it where used.

items.item: H15 (quantifiers, the path result, persisting without end)
items.how: Path result said with decided admission and both paths' admitted pairs in a finite list (Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn's hypotheses); 'one way' no longer labels it; human development's new Proved line gives Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted with its activity, support and descent hypotheses, and the Open line says only that self-concern's ranking of that course is not shown (a bound of this route). In brief uses H15's short form without the hypotheses or a §4.9 cite at that clause (low, left).

items.item: H16 (the condition in time; the one-center bound)
items.how: Short form on the reach line and In brief; no 'over what comes after' joined with 'come to bear'; no per-step 'only from the steps where they do'. One-center line: 'Where the condition holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center (`«续无外则同一中心»`); on a net going forward in time this comes from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before the center's step, and over what comes after two centers can meet it' (07 §4.11's record anchor), matching «续无外当且仅当后与独», «独则同一中心» and TwoSources.apart. Verifier's fix: In brief's in-time sentence now says it is proved on models, as the human development line does.

items.item: H19, H20 and the old frame
items.how: 'and', not 'so', before 'adds no premise' on all four pages (而 in Chinese); no 'counts every continuation'; no unasserted, warrant open, neither asserted, binds no one, C as better or as a second premise, or two readings outside dated history (the valley's 'Until 9 November 2026 … under the two readings' and the bow's quoted entry are history, E10). 04 §8 said in 04's own words (checked at 04-LIFE.md:287).

items.item: Chinese: the handover's 扩展 (medium, fixed)
items.how: In this case 扩展 is the plan Expand; the new C sentence used it for the extension relation ('在一个扩展是否增加一项基本条件已判定之处', '即扩展了后者') right after '也排在扩展之上', so a reader could take it for the plan. Now: '满足 J1/J2 的次序，凡一个方案保有另一方案的一切又有所多出、多出的是否含一项基本条件已有判定之处，也满足 C（`Comparison`，`Priority.comparison`）；在这里，C 要求：一个方案若保有另一方案所具有的每一项基本条件与所得，又多一项所得，就排在后者之上。' Pinned (assertNotIn of the old phrase); dated note in the header comment.
'只要多出的东西里有属于自身延续的，它就把前者排在后者之上', where 它 can be read as the course, is now '这一次序就把前者排在后者之上', as the Chinese first screen now says it. Pinned; dated note.
